name: Donovan D. Dawson
source:
Donovan D. Dawson is the owner and CEO of The Augmented Eye, ex-employer of Kimberly La Vallette and a customer at VA-11 Hall-A.

Donovan has a very crude personality and is often one to speak his mind.[spoiler] Despite his crudeness, however, he appears to be an extremely intelligent man, owning and running The Augmented Eye, and perhaps more impressively, learned Cantonese in just 2 weeks, because he didn't want to be seen with his translator.

Donovan has been married at least twice and is still paying alimony on at least one. Years ago he went to Hong Kong to try to start a silicon business and was in the city during the Hong Kong riots.[/spoiler]
